originalTitle: The latest AI news we announced in October 2026
author: Blog Team

blocks.text: For more than 20 years, we’ve invested in machine learning and AI research, tools, and infrastructure to build products that make everyday life better for more people. Teams across Google are working on ways to unlock AI’s benefits in fields as wide-ranging as healthcare, crisis response, and education. To keep you posted on our progress, we're doing a regular roundup of Google's most recent AI news.
blocks.zh: 二十多年来,我们投资了机器学习和人工智能研究,工具,建造产品,使更多的人能过上更好的日常生活。Google各团队正在研究如何释放AI在保健等广泛领域的好处,危机应对,教育与教育。为了让大家了解我们的进展我们定期对Google最新AI新闻进行综述.
blocks.en: For more than 20 years, we’ve invested in machine learning and AI research, tools, and infrastructure to build products that make everyday life better for more people. Teams across Google are working on ways to unlock AI’s benefits in fields as wide-ranging as healthcare, crisis response, and education. To keep you posted on our progress, we're doing a regular roundup of Google's most recent AI news.

blocks.text: Here’s a look back at some of our AI announcements from October.
blocks.zh: 以下回顾我们10月的一些AI公告。
blocks.en: Here’s a look back at some of our AI announcements from October.

blocks.text: October underscored our commitment to AI innovation, as we released one frontier model globally and announced our next one just two weeks later. After rolling out Gemini 4 Argon — a frontier reasoning model — to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers, we announced Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model yet for long-horizon engineering and cybersecurity defense. Carbon illustrates the pace at which we’re pushing the frontier forward while strengthening our safety guardrails in tandem. Elsewhere in October, we introduced Genie 4 for real-time interactive world simulation with native audio, unveiled our smartest fitness tracker with Google Fitbit Edge, broke open a 20-year bottleneck in quantum computing, and more.
blocks.zh: 10月强调了我们对AI创新的承诺,我们在全球发布了一个前沿模型 并在两周后宣布了我们的下一个模型在向开发者推出Gemini4 Argon——前沿推理模型后,企业,科学家们,和消费者,我们宣布Gemini4号碳,我们最强的模型 远视工程和网络安全防御。碳说明了我们在同步加强安全护栏的同时, 推动前沿前进的步伐。在10月的其他地方,我们引入了Genie 4,用于实时互动世界模拟 与本土音频,在Google Fitbit边上揭开了我们最聪明的健身追踪器在量子计算上打破了20年的瓶颈还有更多
blocks.en: October underscored our commitment to AI innovation, as we released one frontier model globally and announced our next one just two weeks later. After rolling out Gemini 4 Argon — a frontier reasoning model — to developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers, we announced Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model yet for long-horizon engineering and cybersecurity defense. Carbon illustrates the pace at which we’re pushing the frontier forward while strengthening our safety guardrails in tandem. Elsewhere in October, we introduced Genie 4 for real-time interactive world simulation with native audio, unveiled our smartest fitness tracker with Google Fitbit Edge, broke open a 20-year bottleneck in quantum computing, and more.

blocks.text: Put Gemini 4 Argon to work today, and see what’s next for Gemini 4 at the frontier. Following early safety testing, Gemini 4 Argon rolled out globally for complex coding, financial analysis, and legal workflows across Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Google Cloud, Search, and the Gemini app, while also powering physical-world reasoning through Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics. Showing how quickly we’re pushing the frontier forward, two weeks later we announced Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model yet with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities. Just as we did with Argon, we’re taking a deliberate approach to rollout: Carbon is now in pre-release testing with the U.S. government and a subset of trusted cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program as we refine safety guardrails and expand partner testing ahead of a broader launch to developers, businesses, and consumers.
blocks.zh: 让Gemini4Argon今天工作,并看看边境上的Gemini4接下来会是什么。经过早期安全检测后,Gemini4Argon在全球推出 复杂编码,财务分析,和整个谷歌AI工作室的法律工作流程,GeminiAPI,谷歌云号,搜索时,和Gemini的应用,同时通过Gemini4Argon为机器人提供物理世界推理的力量.显示我们如何快速推进前沿,两周后我们宣布Gemini4号碳我们最强的模型 拥有最先进的网络安全和远视能力就像我们对待阿贡一样我们正采取审慎的推出方式:碳现在与美国进行释放前测试.政府和一些值得信赖的网络维权者 通过Fairwind方案,随着我们完善安全防护设施 并扩大伙伴测试 之前,更广泛的发布 开发者,企业,和消费者。
blocks.en: Put Gemini 4 Argon to work today, and see what’s next for Gemini 4 at the frontier. Following early safety testing, Gemini 4 Argon rolled out globally for complex coding, financial analysis, and legal workflows across Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Google Cloud, Search, and the Gemini app, while also powering physical-world reasoning through Gemini 4 Argon for Robotics. Showing how quickly we’re pushing the frontier forward, two weeks later we announced Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model yet with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities. Just as we did with Argon, we’re taking a deliberate approach to rollout: Carbon is now in pre-release testing with the U.S. government and a subset of trusted cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program as we refine safety guardrails and expand partner testing ahead of a broader launch to developers, businesses, and consumers.

blocks.text: Step into real-time interactive worlds with Genie 4. Genie 4 brings unprecedented realism, advanced physics, lifelike human movement, and native audio to real-time interactive simulation. You can steer scenes as they unfold using natural language. Genie 4 advances on our ability to create safe training environments for robots and AI agents as a crucial step toward AGI. Explore the demos on the Google DeepMind blog.
blocks.zh: 步入与Genie 4的实时互动世界.Genie 4带来了前所未有的现实主义高级物理,像生命一样的人类运动,和本地音频到实时交互式模拟。你可以用自然语言来引导场景。Genie 4在为机器人和AI智能体创造安全训练环境的能力上取得了进步,这是朝着AGI迈出的关键一步.探索Google DeepMind博客上的演示.
blocks.en: Step into real-time interactive worlds with Genie 4. Genie 4 brings unprecedented realism, advanced physics, lifelike human movement, and native audio to real-time interactive simulation. You can steer scenes as they unfold using natural language. Genie 4 advances on our ability to create safe training environments for robots and AI agents as a crucial step toward AGI. Explore the demos on the Google DeepMind blog.

blocks.text: Verify AI-generated content more easily around the world. Having already watermarked more than 180 billion images and videos and 240,000 years of audio with SynthID, we’re expanding SynthID Detector globally in English so anyone can check whether an image, video, or audio clip was generated with AI. Alongside built-in verification tools in Search, Chrome, and the Gemini app that regularly handle over a million requests each day, SynthID Detector also identifies AI content from industry partners like OpenAI, NVIDIA, Kakao, and Apple.
blocks.zh: 更方便地在世界各地验证AI生成的内容.已经标注了超过1800亿的图像和视频,以及24万年的合成ID音频,我们用英语在全球扩展合成探测器 这样任何人都可以检查一个图像,视频,或用AI生成音频剪辑.除了搜索中的内置核查工具之外,克罗姆,和Gemini的应用程序 经常每天处理超过100万个请求,合成ID探测器还识别了OpenAI等行业伙伴的AI内容,NVIDIA, (荷兰语).冈子还有苹果
blocks.en: Verify AI-generated content more easily around the world. Having already watermarked more than 180 billion images and videos and 240,000 years of audio with SynthID, we’re expanding SynthID Detector globally in English so anyone can check whether an image, video, or audio clip was generated with AI. Alongside built-in verification tools in Search, Chrome, and the Gemini app that regularly handle over a million requests each day, SynthID Detector also identifies AI content from industry partners like OpenAI, NVIDIA, Kakao, and Apple.

blocks.text: Stay protected from mobile scams with new Android safeguards. AI-powered Scam Detection in Phone by Google and Google Messages already flags more than 5 million suspected scam calls and texts every month. Now, Android is introducing an opt-in Enhanced protection mode in Google Messages that uses Private AI Compute and our latest cloud Gemini models to catch sophisticated conversational scams, paired with expanded chat alerts and stronger call-forwarding and screen-sharing defenses.
blocks.zh: 用新的Android保障措施来防止移动骗局。由Google和Google Messages制作的AI功能Scam Phone侦测器已经每月标出超过500万个疑似骗局电话和短信.现在,Android在Google Messages中引入了选入强化保护模式,该模式使用Private AI Compute和我们最新的云Gemini模型来捕捉精密的对话.骗局,配以扩展的聊天提示以及更强大的呼叫前导和屏幕共享防御.
blocks.en: Stay protected from mobile scams with new Android safeguards. AI-powered Scam Detection in Phone by Google and Google Messages already flags more than 5 million suspected scam calls and texts every month. Now, Android is introducing an opt-in Enhanced protection mode in Google Messages that uses Private AI Compute and our latest cloud Gemini models to catch sophisticated conversational scams, paired with expanded chat alerts and stronger call-forwarding and screen-sharing defenses.

blocks.text: Meet Google Fitbit Edge, our all-new smartest fitness tracker ever. Available now in a slim, comfortable design with up to seven days of battery life 1, Fitbit Edge 2 pairs precision GPS and automatic workout recognition across 50+ activities with personalized guidance from the Gemini-powered Google Health Coach 3 We also rolled out more than 55 updates across Google Health and Fitbit Air, including effortless photo meal logging, new Metal Mesh bands, and Health Guardian features that monitor long-term blood pressure and insulin resistance trends 4.
blocks.zh: 满足 Google Fitbit 边缘,我们的全新最聪明的健身赛车手现在已经很瘦了,舒适的设计,最多7天的电池寿命1,Fitbit Edge 2对精准的GPS和在Gemini驱动的Google Google健康教练3的个性化指导下,在50多个活动中进行自动解决识别在Google Health和Fitbit Air上发布了超过55个更新,包括不费力的光食记录,新的金属网格带,《卫报》监测长期血压和胰岛素抗药性趋势的特征
blocks.en: Meet Google Fitbit Edge, our all-new smartest fitness tracker ever. Available now in a slim, comfortable design with up to seven days of battery life 1, Fitbit Edge 2 pairs precision GPS and automatic workout recognition across 50+ activities with personalized guidance from the Gemini-powered Google Health Coach 3 We also rolled out more than 55 updates across Google Health and Fitbit Air, including effortless photo meal logging, new Metal Mesh bands, and Health Guardian features that monitor long-term blood pressure and insulin resistance trends 4.

blocks.text: See how AI could improve patient-physician relationships in clinical care. In Google’s first publication in the main journal of The Lancet, researchers from Google and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center evaluated our AMIE conversational medical AI system during real-world primary care clinic visits. By gathering patient histories and generating clinical summaries before urgent care appointments, AMIE helped clinicians prepare in 75% of cases and matched doctors’ final differential diagnoses 90% of the time. This is part of our broader work applying AI to better understand, detect, and treat disease.
blocks.zh: 参见AI如何改善临床护理中的病人与医生的关系.在Google在《柳叶刀》主要期刊上的第一份出版物中,来自Google和Beth Israel Deaconess医疗中心的研究人员在现实世界初级保健诊所访问时评价了我们的AMIE对话医疗AI系统。通过收集病人的病历和在紧急护理预约之前制作临床摘要,AMIE帮助临床医生为75%的病例做准备,并与医生最终诊断的90%的时间相匹配。这是我们应用AI来更好地理解的更广泛工作的一部分,探测,并治疗疾病。
blocks.en: See how AI could improve patient-physician relationships in clinical care. In Google’s first publication in the main journal of The Lancet, researchers from Google and Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center evaluated our AMIE conversational medical AI system during real-world primary care clinic visits. By gathering patient histories and generating clinical summaries before urgent care appointments, AMIE helped clinicians prepare in 75% of cases and matched doctors’ final differential diagnoses 90% of the time. This is part of our broader work applying AI to better understand, detect, and treat disease.

blocks.text: Create and play custom games in Playground. Our new experimental gaming platform lets anyone build, remix, and share custom single- and multiplayer games from simple text prompts with zero coding required. That same no-code creativity is expanding across our platforms: Android users can now build personal AI apps with Google AI Studio and install them directly on their phones through Google Play, and music producers can vibe code custom instruments and audio plugins in Google Flow Music.
blocks.zh: 在 Playground 中创建和玩自定义游戏 。我们的新实验游戏平台 让任何人建造,重新混合,并共享自定义的单玩和多人游戏,来自需要零编码的简单文本提示.同样的无码创意正在我们各个平台扩展:Android用户现在可以使用Google AI Studio构建个人AI应用程序,并通过Google Play直接安装在手机上,而音乐制作人可以在Google Flow Music中发声代码自定义乐器和音频插件.
blocks.en: Create and play custom games in Playground. Our new experimental gaming platform lets anyone build, remix, and share custom single- and multiplayer games from simple text prompts with zero coding required. That same no-code creativity is expanding across our platforms: Android users can now build personal AI apps with Google AI Studio and install them directly on their phones through Google Play, and music producers can vibe code custom instruments and audio plugins in Google Flow Music.

blocks.text: Celebrate educators and sharpen your learning. For World Teachers’ Day, teachers from around the globe shared how they use Gemini to personalize lessons and spark critical thinking, alongside a new global idea search launched in partnership with TED. Whether you’re in the classroom or preparing for a big project, you can also study smarter with Gemini Notebook using interactive learning overviews and custom quizzes, and use new co-creation controls to shape your Slide Decks and Video Overviews before they generate.
blocks.zh: 庆祝教育家, 并磨练你的学习。世界教师日,来自世界各地的教师分享了他们如何利用Gemini来将课程个性化并激发批判性思维,与TED合作发起新的全球思想搜索。无论是在课堂上,还是准备一个大项目,也可以使用Gemini笔记书使用交互式学习综述和自定义问答来进行智能化学习,并使用新的共创控件来塑造您的幻灯片 Decks 和视频概览,然后它们才会生成。
blocks.en: Celebrate educators and sharpen your learning. For World Teachers’ Day, teachers from around the globe shared how they use Gemini to personalize lessons and spark critical thinking, alongside a new global idea search launched in partnership with TED. Whether you’re in the classroom or preparing for a big project, you can also study smarter with Gemini Notebook using interactive learning overviews and custom quizzes, and use new co-creation controls to shape your Slide Decks and Video Overviews before they generate.

blocks.text: Build privacy-first multimodal search with EmbeddingGemma 2. Engineered on the Gemma 4 architecture with 740 million parameters, our new open embedding model moves beyond text to map code, images, video, and audio into a single unified space right on everyday devices. Its modular design cuts local vector storage by up to 6x, making it easy for developers to build private, offline apps that can find a specific video clip from a voice memo or search hours of audio with a text query.
blocks.zh: 使用 EmbeddingGemma 2 构建隐私首个多模式搜索 。设计了Gemma 4的建筑,有7.4亿个参数,我们新的开放式嵌入模式 超越文本到映射代码,图像,视频,在日常设备上,音频进入一个统一的空间。它的模块化设计将本地矢量存储削减了最多6x,使开发者们可以轻松地建造私人建筑,可以从语音备忘录中找到特定视频剪辑的离线应用程序,或者通过文本查询搜索音频的时数.
blocks.en: Build privacy-first multimodal search with EmbeddingGemma 2. Engineered on the Gemma 4 architecture with 740 million parameters, our new open embedding model moves beyond text to map code, images, video, and audio into a single unified space right on everyday devices. Its modular design cuts local vector storage by up to 6x, making it easy for developers to build private, offline apps that can find a specific video clip from a voice memo or search hours of audio with a text query.

blocks.text: Read the first AI response beamed back from our Project Suncatcher satellite. After launching TPUs into low-Earth orbit, our first Project Suncatcher prototype satellite returned the first-ever AI response generated by a data center-class Google TPU in space: a haiku composed onboard by Gemma 4. This milestone confirms our hardware survived launch and can run AI workloads in orbit. Our team will continue to test how the chips handle radiation and thermal extremes while harnessing space’s abundant solar energy as part of a long-term moonshot toward scalable orbital AI infrastructure.
blocks.zh: 阅读第一个AI反应波束 从我们的太阳捕捉者项目卫星回来。在将TPU发射到低地球轨道后,我们的第一颗Suncatcher项目原型卫星返回了第一个由数据中心级的Google TPU在空间生成的AI响应:由Gemma 4编成的海库这个里程碑证实了我们的硬件在发射中幸存下来,并且可以在轨道上运行AI的工作量.我们的团队将继续测试芯片如何处理辐射和热极,同时利用太空丰富的太阳能,作为长期射向可伸缩的卫星的一部分。轨道AI基础设施.
blocks.en: Read the first AI response beamed back from our Project Suncatcher satellite. After launching TPUs into low-Earth orbit, our first Project Suncatcher prototype satellite returned the first-ever AI response generated by a data center-class Google TPU in space: a haiku composed onboard by Gemma 4. This milestone confirms our hardware survived launch and can run AI workloads in orbit. Our team will continue to test how the chips handle radiation and thermal extremes while harnessing space’s abundant solar energy as part of a long-term moonshot toward scalable orbital AI infrastructure.

blocks.text: See how our latest research is accelerating scientific discovery. At our annual Research@ 2026 event, we shared new ways we’re putting advanced AI in the hands of scientists and experts — including demonstrating an experimental Geospatial Reasoning agent, opening public access to our Deep Review tool for technical papers, and delivering top-ranked flu hospitalization forecasting. These breakthroughs are part of a broader, company-wide effort to push the boundaries of scientific discovery. Beyond the event, Google teams are also advancing planetary research by mapping the world’s forest types, while Google.org has awarded $36 million to 17 organizations accelerating scientific breakthroughs with AI.
blocks.zh: 看看我们的最新研究是如何加速科学发现的.在2026年的年度研究中,我们分享了将高级人工智能交给科学家和专家的新方式,包括展示一种试验性地理空间理性剂,开放公众获取技术论文的深度审查工具,并进行排行榜最高的流感住院预测。这些突破是更广泛的,整个公司都在努力推动科学发现的界限。在事件之后,Google团队也通过绘制世界森林类型图来推进行星研究,而Google.org则向17个与AI加速科学突破的组织授予了3600万美元.
blocks.en: See how our latest research is accelerating scientific discovery. At our annual Research@ 2026 event, we shared new ways we’re putting advanced AI in the hands of scientists and experts — including demonstrating an experimental Geospatial Reasoning agent, opening public access to our Deep Review tool for technical papers, and delivering top-ranked flu hospitalization forecasting. These breakthroughs are part of a broader, company-wide effort to push the boundaries of scientific discovery. Beyond the event, Google teams are also advancing planetary research by mapping the world’s forest types, while Google.org has awarded $36 million to 17 organizations accelerating scientific breakthroughs with AI.

blocks.text: See how we broke open a 20-year bottleneck in quantum computing. In a landmark study published in Science, Google Quantum AI demonstrated that a technique called "magic state cultivation" works in practice on our Willow quantum processor, cutting errors roughly 40-fold compared to uncultivated states. Because producing high-purity magic states previously threatened to consume up to 95% of a quantum computer’s resources, this breakthrough clears a major hurdle on the path to large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers.
blocks.zh: 看看我们在量子计算方面如何打破了20年的瓶颈.在科学杂志上发表的一份划时代的研究报告中,Google Quantum AI证明一种叫做"魔法状态栽培"的技术在我们的柳质量子处理器上实际上是有效的,与未开垦的状态相比,剪切错误大约40倍。因为生产高纯度魔法的状态 以前威胁要消耗高达95%的量子计算机资源,这一突破清除了通往大规模道路的一大障碍,容错量子计算机.
blocks.en: See how we broke open a 20-year bottleneck in quantum computing. In a landmark study published in Science, Google Quantum AI demonstrated that a technique called "magic state cultivation" works in practice on our Willow quantum processor, cutting errors roughly 40-fold compared to uncultivated states. Because producing high-purity magic states previously threatened to consume up to 95% of a quantum computer’s resources, this breakthrough clears a major hurdle on the path to large-scale, fault-tolerant quantum computers.

translation: Argos Open Tech 1.9 / offline machine translation
